title: Astra with MCP made me a geonode repeating scatter system with Rotation Bound collision detection. Wow. I doubted it would be able to do this.
author: Odd-Pie7133
selftext:
I needed floating debris and other objects inside a body of water. Since they can spawn at arbitrary rotations and later slowly sink and rotate in-game, I wanted their initial placement to be collision-safe regardless of orientation - so, for example, a long plank wouldn't spawn intersecting a floating piece of paper. And it would guarantee collision-free movement with random rotation, given that all objects go down with the same velocity.

I wasn't really sure how I'd build that kind of scatter system in Geometry Nodes, but then I remembered seeing a post about using MCP with Blender, so I figured I'd give it a try.

And... it actually did it.
